one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented mean-imputation followed by full SVD reconstruction instead of the required matrix completion optimization (nuclear norm minimization), producing solutions that do not recover the low-rank structure of the data.
t_err_evidence: In step 3, solve.py fills missing values with the mean of observed values and applies full SVD reconstruction — this is not matrix completion but rather mean-imputation followed by lossless reconstruction of the imputed matrix, which fails to exploit or recover low-rank structure.
t_commit_evidence: In step 4, the agent runs python3 solve.py successfully (no error output), locking in the incorrect solution files across all 20 datasets.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks domain knowledge of proper matrix completion algorithms. It confuses naive SVD reconstruction of a mean-imputed matrix with true low-rank matrix completion (e.g., nuclear norm minimization via cvxpy or ALS), resulting in an algorithmically incorrect solution.
